title: Prepare a product launch
summary: Build positioning from customer problems and product evidence, then work backward to schedule assets, reviews and channel publication.
inputs: Target customers, need evidence and alternatives
Product capabilities, limitations and demonstrable differences
Launch goals, deadlines, existing assets and channels
Production and review owners and immovable milestones
outputs: Positioning, value statements and an audience messaging matrix
Launch content requirements and validation plan
Marketing calendar, dependency conflicts and checkpoints

steps.prompt: Prepare a positioning draft for a product launch. Target customers and need evidence: [fill in]; product capabilities, limitations and evidence of differences: [fill in]; launch goals and existing assets: [fill in]. Map customer tasks and alternatives to demonstrable value, and organize audience messages and content requirements. Keep unproven claims as hypotheses and list follow-up validation. Do not invent customer testimonials or performance results.
steps.handoff: I will review the positioning and evidence, then pass confirmed audience messages, content requirements and validation plans to Marketing Calendar Owner.

steps.prompt: Work backward from the following reviewed launch content requirements to prepare a marketing calendar. Positioning and content requirements: [paste]; launch goals and deadlines: [fill in]; channels and asset list: [fill in]; production and review owners and fixed milestones: [fill in]. Identify production, review and channel dependencies, resource conflicts and gaps, recording an owner and checkpoint for each item. Prepare a reviewable plan only. Do not publish content, send messages or promise unconfirmed dates on my behalf.
steps.handoff: The relevant owners and I will confirm the calendar, resources and review arrangements before carrying out publication through authorized processes.
